requirements.answer_quote:
| 软件概念 | 硬件落点 |
|---|---|
| Grid | 整个 GPU（所有 SM）；块由调度器以任意顺序分发 |
| Block | **恰好一个 SM**，生命周期内不迁移 |
| Warp | SM 内的调度单位，由 warp scheduler 发射 |
| Thread | 执行上下文（PC + 寄存器），驻留 SM 的片上寄存器堆 |
requirements.evidence_quote: When an SM is given one or more thread blocks to execute, it partitions them into warps and each warp gets scheduled for execution by a *warp scheduler*.
